newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices up on poor volumes.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices up on poor volumes.

text.p: Indian castorseed December delivery prices gained further on Tuesday while the U.S. missile attack on Iraq sent groundnut oil prices up, traders said.
"Volumes were poor and reports of sliding arrivals at producing centres kept the market firm," one trader said.
He said export demand for castoroil was low and would remain so in view of the U.S. attack.
Groundnut oil rose to 432/433 rupees per 10 kg from 428/429 rupees. "Fear of restricted arrivals of imported palm oil following the Gulf crisis also dragged groundnut oil prices up," one miller said.
